description_en: Creates an ADB key pair. You can use ADB to connect to a cloud phone for device management, application management, and file transfers. ADB operations require elevated permissions. Cloud phones lack physical interfaces, so you cannot trigger a device-side authorization dialog box over USB. Therefore, when ADB connects to a cloud phone over a network, you must configure a key pair in advance to establish trust between the device and the client and ensure secure operations. You can invoke the CreateKeyPair operation to create an ADB key pair. The system stores the public key and returns the private key in the PKCS#8 format with PEM encoding that complies with ADB connection specifications. You must securely store the private key
description_zh: 用户可以通过ADB连接云手机，对云手机进行设备管理、应用管理、文件传输等操作。由于其操作权限较大且云手机没有物理接口，无法通过 USB 触发设备端的授权对话框。因此adb通过网络连接云手机，必须预先配置密钥对，让设备信任客户端，确保操作的安全。调用本接口CreateKeyPair可创建一对ADB密钥对。系统会为您保管密钥的公钥部分，并返回符合ADB连接规范的PEM编码的PKCS#8格式私钥。您需要自行妥善保管私钥部分
name: CreateKeyPair

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为 2~128 个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

KeyPairId.description_en: The ID of the ADB key pair

KeyPairName.description_en: The name of the key pair

PrivateKeyBody.description_en: The private key of the key pair. The private key is in the PEM-encoded PKCS#8 format that complies with ADB key pair specifications
PrivateKeyBody.description_zh: 密钥对的私钥。符合ADB密钥对规范的PEM 编码的 PKCS#8 格式的私钥部分
